description: SISTERS, OR— Deschutes County Commissioner Patti Adair, candidate for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District, released this statement today: “My heart is shattered for the families, students, and victims of today’s horrific shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. I am praying for everyone impacted. No words can fully express the pain our community is feeling right now. I am temporarily suspending all campaign events to stand with those grieving and offer whatever support I can.”

title: Patti Adair’s Statement on today’s tragedy at Silver Rail Elementary
